_note: Illustrative SEP-2640 skills/get entry: a STATIC, digest-pinned resource set — the safe counterpart to the dynamic-resource sleeper. Every file carries a sha256 digest the host re-verifies against the fetched bytes, so the bytes reviewed at approval are the bytes that run; any change to the uri/digest set revokes approval and re-prompts. Digests are placeholder/inert.
